outcome: mean pulsatility index (PI) of the uterine artery Doppler
birth weight < 10th percentile for gestational age
cohort: Pregnant women who had their deliveries between March 2014 and February 2023.
finding: The number of previous cesarean sections had a significant influence on the mean pulsatility index of the uterine artery Doppler between 20-34 weeks of gestation and was an independent predictor of postpartum hemorrhage and APGAR score at the 5th minute < 7.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was associated with a higher mean pulsatility index of the uterine artery Doppler and was an independent predictor of postpartum hemorrhage and APGAR score at the 5th minute < 7.
